'''Sithlord119 Power Of The Dark Side (revised)''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Sithlord119]]
* '''Published:''' 1 May 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Naboo: Theed Palace Generator Core|Ref3-D-nabootheedpalacegeneratorcore.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Naboo: Theed Palace Generator Core
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 Naboo Theed Palace Generator Core.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

As it the name states Power. Revised edition due to one to manny cards and also comments.

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

The basic strategy is this you Have Vader and Maul each at one location Theed Palace Generator Core and Theed Palace Generator

there they can force drain away and if someone comes you have supprot cards for them. Keep a Storm trooper garrison with Vader that makes 2 battle destiny and Vader cannot be targeted by weapons ,keep Fett with him thats an additional 2 or him with Aurra at an opponents site. Then the Emperor is at the throne room if need be can add a battle destiny keep a garrison on stand by if Jar Jat comes around since jerrjeroid means no spies(This means that with jerjeroid Jar Jar is all you have to worry about I should have made that make more sense). Then Sidous is on the bridge with loads of reinforcements in the hallway no one can get in any Jedi that dies will never ever come back again. All so simple in it's
